representation: Persistent original 2D raster skins, hierarchical fixed-length native Rive bones/limits, deterministic contact IK and cloth-only inverse-skin floor correctives

independent_verification.independent_fk: 2x3 affine matrix composition; root orientation * mirror * parent-tip * local rotation; no planner import
independent_verification.interpolation: Native linear on root x/y, orientation and local bone rotations; constant mirror
independent_verification.contact_schedule: ankle_grip throughout; hip_sole/far_leg_hook only through 5.25 seconds
independent_verification.alpha_ground_method: alpha>=128 pixel-support convex hull mapped through mesh UV and original global bind; rigid foot/head/hand-near layers only; cloth pose-correctives excluded; raster filtering can shift edge about one source pixel

native_overlay_raster.scope: Nearby cyan/orange raster support, not extraction of native numeric bone transforms

scope_limits: Native clamp numerical behavior is separate from plan FK

native_limit_enforcement.engine: Rive CLI1.9.2 actual M4 positive-angle/mirrored-parent limit proof

native_inspect.disposition: 56 interpolated-step advisories on dense linear cloth correction keys entering a held pose. Continuous interpolation is intended; no hold-mode substitution or warning suppression. These are not reported as zero problems.
